answer: The lagoon detector writes to dune, and saffron makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 51 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, as a result the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 216 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
